SELECT id, name, phone, address, detail_address AS detailAddress, latitude, longitude, is_emergency_24h AS isEmergency24h, business_hours AS businessHours, rating, review_count AS reviewCount, naver_place_url AS naverPlaceUrl, is_active AS isActive, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(latitude)) * cos(radians(longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(latitude)))) AS distance FROM hospitals WHERE is_active = TRUE
AND is_emergency_24h = TRUE
ORDER BY distance ASC

SELECT id, name, phone, address, detail_address AS detailAddress, latitude, longitude, is_emergency_24h AS isEmergency24h, business_hours AS businessHours, rating, review_count AS reviewCount, naver_place_url AS naverPlaceUrl, is_active AS isActive FROM hospitals WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hospitals (name, phone, address, detail_address, latitude, longitude, is_emergency_24h, business_hours, rating, review_count, naver_place_url, is_active) VALUES (#{name}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{detailAddress}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{isEmergency24h}, #{businessHours}, #{rating}, #{reviewCount}, #{naverPlaceUrl}, #{isActive})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, phone, address, detail_address AS detailAddress, latitude, longitude, is_emergency_24h AS isEmergency24h, business_hours AS businessHours, rating, review_count AS reviewCount, naver_place_url AS naverPlaceUrl, is_active AS isActive FROM hospitals WHERE REPLACE(name, ' ', '') = REPLACE(#{name}, ' ', '') AND REPLACE(address, ' ', '') = REPLACE(#{address}, ' ', '') LIMIT 1
